# Nuclear plugin fixtures

Release zips of real plugins from Nuclear's plugin registry, used to test Raygun's Nuclear
compatibility layer (M17). Each is AGPL-3.0-only, like Raygun, and unmodified.

| File                             | Source                                                      | Version | License       |
| -------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------- | ------- | ------------- |
| `nuclear-plugin-musicbrainz.zip` | https://github.com/NuclearPlayer/nuclear-plugin-musicbrainz | 0.1.0   | AGPL-3.0-only |
| `nuclear-plugin-lrclib.zip`      | https://github.com/NuclearPlayer/nuclear-plugin-lrclib      | 0.1.0   | AGPL-3.0-only |
| `nuclear-plugin-kugou.zip`       | https://github.com/NuclearPlayer/nuclear-plugin-kugou       | 0.1.0   | AGPL-3.0-only |
| `nuclear-plugin-discogs.zip`     | https://github.com/NuclearPlayer/nuclear-plugin-discogs     | 0.2.0   | AGPL-3.0-only |

Copyright belongs to the plugins' authors (the NuclearPlayer project).
